storyChalet.title: Our story: Passion for paws
storyChalet.paragraph1: S&P Ring Pet Care was founded by Sarah with a simple mission: to treat every animal as if they were her own family. Operating across Clarksville, TN, we offer reliable, personalized pet sitting and drop-in check-ups built on trust and absolute peace of mind.
storyChalet.paragraph2: We specialize in accommodating pets with complex routines or medical profiles—ensuring seizure medications are given exactly on time, twice a day, so you can travel without worry.
storyChalet.imageAlt: A happy dog playing outdoors with its walker

items.name: Ariana Cruz
items.quote: “We couldn’t be happier with Sara! She took such amazing care of our pup while we were away! Lots of walks, playtime, and sweet updates that gave us total peace of mind. Highly recommend!”

items.quote: “Sara helped me out with making sure my pets were fed and most importantly my dog had her medicine when I was out of town. My dog has seizures so it was important it was on time. She didn't fail me!!”

items.name: Logan York
items.quote: “Always trust her with our baby Merlin. She's come over and done drop-ins for us multiple times and is always respectful of our home and our pup loves her.”

services.title: Dog Sitting & Boarding
services.shortDescription: Overnight care in your home or ours to keep your pet relaxed and loved.
services.longDescription: We understand pets are happiest in their familiar environments. Our overnight pet sitting ensures your dog keeps their standard sleeping schedule, morning walks, and feeding patterns intact.
